summary: Completed frontend-only regression testing on the public Panificadora Carvalho app. Logo, hero, all 24 product images, catalog filtering/search, cart quantity totals, delivery validation, WhatsApp handoff, confirmation state, and mobile overflow all passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public URL at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Validated 24 loaded product images, bolo caseiro hero mapping, category/search behavior, cart decrement and totals, delivery address blocking, WhatsApp popup, sent state, and no horizontal overflow. Currency values include a non-breaking space and should be asserted accordingly.
rca of the issue: No application defect reproduced. One initial automation assertion used an exact currency string and failed because Brazilian formatting contains a non-breaking space; the corrected assertion passed. A subsequent test also had a malformed test-only f-string, then the corrected run passed all remaining flows.
